label: TESS/TESS Lightcurve
name: TESS Lightcurve
description: The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) is a NASA space mission designed to survey the sky for transiting exoplanets and variable astrophysical sources. TESS produces time-series photometric light curves, which are released separately for each observing sector. This catalog contains TESS light curve files indexed by their corresponding TESS Input Catalog (TIC) identifiers.
